plan.notes: Source: Gadsden State Community College 2026-2027 Catalog, General Studies A.S. at https://catalog.gadsdenstate.edu/general-studies/general-studies-as. The catalog publishes program requirements with no official semester-by-semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. Choice slots recorded at minimum credit per convention. Area I 6 + Area II 12 + Area III 11 + Area IV 12 + Area V 22 = 63; the catalog publishes the degree total as 60-64. Area V courses are selected with an advisor for the intended transfer major (see alabamatransfers.com).
